review: Read complete panel, API helper and tests plus exact public-preview diff. First-party React/TypeScript; synthetic room/result identities and mocked HTTP only. No credentials, private profiles, game assets or external source copied.

The sole delta treats room_result_account_policy_blocked like the existing developer-required rejection when hiding the owner results panel. No new account-mode gate is introduced; server admission remains authoritative.

Catalog reads expose metadata and verify exact room/mission/revision identities. Hosted catalogs use the shared strict schema. Selecting a report and consenting explicitly are required before an explanation request; question or location changes clear consent.

Explanation retries retain the same source request identity. A private HTTP answer is never rendered as the public answer; only the room projection matching its turn ID marks publication. Account change/unmount abort UI continuations and suppress late callback/results.

The unchanged helper sends an explicit report selection to the existing Ask route. This source proposal does not alter provider dispatch, funding, task delegation, server authority or idempotency enforcement.
